title: A waiting room lets a spike in at the rate the core can take
caption: The crowd hits a cheap edge page and a FIFO line. The core only sees users who hold a signed admission token.

steps.text: Everyone who arrives gets a static page from the edge. It's cheap to serve, so the spike lands here and not on the core.
Each user is appended to a FIFO line in a fast store and shown a position and ETA. When the line is full, new arrivals are told to come back later.
The admitter pops users at the rate the core can sustain and issues each one a signed, short-lived admission token.
Only token holders reach the core, which checks the token on every request. The core's load stays flat however big the crowd is.
